diagnostic_delta_g_j_mol.derivation_comment: Premise: the SF04 K2O-silicate constants cite Hastie & Bonnell (1985), but that K2O(l) anchor remains unconfirmed. The repository contains no JANAF-3 K2O(l) entry, and no primary printed JANAF-3 K2O(l) values could be verified; this is one-sided, not a two-source bound. Algebra: ΔG_a(T)=2G°(K,g)+G°(O,g)+RT ln(10)(15.33−36735/T)−G°(K2O,l;K-012); E(T)=|ΔG_a(T)|. The equivalent row magnitude is ν_K2O E(T)/(RT ln 10). Unit check: G° and RT ln K are J/mol; dividing nu E(T) by R T ln(10) gives a dimensionless log10 K magnitude. Sanity check: ΔG_a is positive at all five temperatures and is about 3.62, 2.46, 2.03, 2.92, and 6.51 kJ/mol; KCaAlSi2O7 uses ν_K2O=0.5.

diagnostic_delta_g_j_mol.derivation_comment: Premise: the SF04 K2O-silicate constants cite Hastie & Bonnell (1985), but that K2O(l) anchor remains unconfirmed. The repository contains no JANAF-3 K2O(l) entry, and no primary printed JANAF-3 K2O(l) values could be verified; this is one-sided, not a two-source bound. Algebra: ΔG_a(T)=2G°(K,g)+G°(O,g)+RT ln(10)(15.33−36735/T)−G°(K2O,l;K-012); E(T)=|ΔG_a(T)|. The equivalent row magnitude is ν_K2O E(T)/(RT ln 10). Unit check: G° and RT ln K are J/mol; dividing nu E(T) by R T ln(10) gives a dimensionless log10 K magnitude. Sanity check: ΔG_a is positive at all five temperatures and is about 3.62, 2.46, 2.03, 2.92, and 6.51 kJ/mol; KCaAlSi2O7 uses ν_K2O=0.5.

The repository contains no JANAF-3 K2O(l) entry, and no primary printed JANAF-3 K2O(l) values could be verified; this is one-sided, not a two-source bound. Algebra: ΔG_a(T)=2G°(K,g)+G°(O,g)+RT ln(10)(15.33−36735/T)−G°(K2O,l;K-012); E(T)=|ΔG_a(T)|. The equivalent row magnitude is ν_K2O E(T)/(RT ln 10). Unit check: G° and RT ln K are J/mol; dividing nu E(T) by R T ln(10) gives a dimensionless log10 K magnitude. Sanity check: ΔG_a is positive at all five temperatures and is about 3.62, 2.46, 2.03, 2.92, and 6.51 kJ/mol; KCaAlSi2O7 uses ν_K2O=0.5.

Algebra: ΔG_a(T)=2G°(K,g)+G°(O,g)+RT ln(10)(15.33−36735/T)−G°(K2O,l;K-012); E(T)=|ΔG_a(T)|. The equivalent row magnitude is ν_K2O E(T)/(RT ln 10). Unit check: G° and RT ln K are J/mol; dividing nu E(T) by R T ln(10) gives a dimensionless log10 K magnitude. Sanity check: ΔG_a is positive at all five temperatures and is about 3.62, 2.46, 2.03, 2.92, and 6.51 kJ/mol; KCaAlSi2O7 uses ν_K2O=0.5.
